title: Black Friday Video Ads From One Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: Build a Black Friday video ad from one product photo, then add the confirmed offer after download. Choose a scene for social feeds and product pages.
h1: Show the Black Friday Deal Before the Rush
lead: Turn one product photo into a Black Friday video ad video that gives shoppers a clear result, ready for the channel where you sell.

steps.d: Add one clear source photo and keep the full product or garment visible. Use a photo that matches the item in your Black Friday offer.
Choose one offer scene and describe the setting shoppers should see. Keep the product central while the cost stays visible before you run it.
Download the result and add exact price, code or end date in your editor. Post the finished clip where the offer appears.

faq.a: Use one sharp photo with the full product visible and enough light to show its shape and finish.

faq.q: What result does this template show?
faq.a: It creates a Black Friday video ad that keeps the product clear while leaving the exact offer details for your editor.

faq.q: Which length or format should I choose?
faq.a: Use 6 seconds for one price beat, 10 or 15 seconds for a product action, or 30 seconds for a fuller offer story. Choose 9:16 for Stories and Reels or 1:1 for a square feed.

faq.q: Can I change details after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add or update the confirmed price, discount, code and end date as editable text after download.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot day?
faq.a: No. Start with the product photo you already have and choose a deal scene instead of booking a creator, location or gear.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: Use the downloaded clip in your own paid social ads, product pages and posts where the chosen format fits. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark.
